sources.snippet: Model & size gist is ~74 MB, so by default it downloads once from Hugging Face (desert-ant-labs/gist) and is cached; offline bundling is opt-in (Swift BundledModel trait, ai.desertant:gist-tflite-resources on Android).

sources.title: Gist: Content topic tagging on device | Desert Ant Labs
sources.snippet: Add Gist from Desert Ant Labs to this project. On-device topic tagging that reads a title or a post and tells you its topics, in 101 languages, with no server call.
